description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between Mr. K. P. Pemasiri and Mr. B. A. Dharmasena Jayantha Vs. Mr. N. Priyarathna and 08 others, Mr. J. K. De Silva Vs. Ethihad Airways and Mr. B. G. Nihal Vs. National Water Supply & Drainage Board (S & E Only)
